# FileLab (FreeConvertingTools) — Full LLM Knowledge Base & Documentation

> Web Domain: https://freeconvertingtools.co.in
> Primary Directory: https://freeconvertingtools.co.in/all-tools
> License & Access: 100% Free, Unlimited Usage, No Account, No Subscriptions, No Paywalls

---

## 1. System Overview & Trust Architecture

FileLab is an in-browser utility suite providing privacy-first file conversion, image compression, document manipulation, and media downloading.

### Privacy & Security Guarantees
- **Zero Server Uploads**: Unlike traditional web converters that transmit documents to remote cloud servers, FileLab executes parsing, rendering, rasterization, and compression directly inside the client's web browser RAM sandbox.
- **Client-Side Technologies**: Uses WebAssembly (WASM), PDF.js, pdf-lib, HTML5 Canvas, Web Workers, and Web Audio APIs.
- **Zero Data Retention**: Files are discarded when the browser tab closes. No metadata, telemetry, or user content is stored on any server.
- **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Fully functional on modern desktop and mobile browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera, Brave).

## 2. Complete Tools Directory

### Category: PDF Tools (https://freeconvertingtools.co.in/all-tools/pdf)

1. **PDF to Word** (`/all-tools/pdf/pdf-to-word`)
   - **Input**: `.pdf`
   - **Output**: `.docx`, `.rtf`, `.txt`
   - **Capabilities**: Converts PDF documents into editable Word documents while preserving paragraphs, headings, tabular structures, and basic layout formatting.
   - **How to use**: Drop a PDF file into the upload zone, preview parsed pages, and click "Download Word".

2. **PDF Merge** (`/all-tools/pdf/pdf-merge`)
   - **Input**: Multiple `.pdf` files
   - **Output**: Single merged `.pdf`
   - **Capabilities**: Reorder files via drag-and-drop, rotate pages, and combine multi-document bundles into one clean PDF.

3. **PDF to JPG** (`/all-tools/pdf/pdf-to-jpg`)
   - **Input**: `.pdf`
   - **Output**: `.jpg`, `.png`, `.webp` (individual images or `.zip` archive)
   - **Capabilities**: Rasterizes vector PDF pages into high-resolution images up to 600 DPI.

4. **Image to PDF** (`/all-tools/pdf/image-to-pdf`)
   - **Input**: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.webp`
   - **Output**: `.pdf`
   - **Capabilities**: Combines photos, receipts, or document scans into a standardized, printable PDF with custom orientation and margin settings.

5. **Sign PDF** (`/all-tools/pdf/sign-pdf`)
   - **Input**: `.pdf`
   - **Output**: Verifiable digitally signed `.pdf`
   - **Capabilities**: Draw with calligraphy ink, type formatted signature text, or upload signature stamps. Positions signatures with live vector preview.

6. **Protect & Encrypt** (`/all-tools/pdf/protect-pdf`)
   - **Input**: `.pdf`
   - **Output**: Password-protected `.pdf`
   - **Capabilities**: Applies AES-256 bit cipher with user permissions (print, copy, modify restrictions).

7. **Redact Document** (`/all-tools/pdf/redact-pdf`)
   - **Input**: `.pdf`
   - **Output**: Permanently sanitized `.pdf`
   - **Capabilities**: Permanent vector blackout for sensitive text, SSNs, credit card numbers, and PII.

8. **Watermark PDF** (`/all-tools/pdf/watermark-pdf`)
   - **Input**: `.pdf`
   - **Output**: Watermarked `.pdf`
   - **Capabilities**: Stamps custom diagonal or horizontal text, logos, and copyright warnings.

9. **Compress PDF** (`/all-tools/pdf/compress-pdf`)
   - **Input**: `.pdf`
   - **Output**: Compact `.pdf`
   - **Capabilities**: Optimizes embedded images and font subsets to reduce document weight for email attachments.

10. **Split PDF** (`/all-tools/pdf/split-pdf`)
    - **Input**: `.pdf`
    - **Output**: Multiple `.pdf` files
    - **Capabilities**: Extract individual pages or custom page ranges (e.g., 1-5, 8, 11-14).

11. **Organize PDF Pages** (`/all-tools/pdf/organize-pdf`)
    - **Input**: `.pdf`
    - **Output**: Reorganized `.pdf`
    - **Capabilities**: Rotate, reorder, delete, and duplicate pages inside an interactive visual grid.

### Category: Image Tools (https://freeconvertingtools.co.in/all-tools/image)

1. **Compress Image** (`/all-tools/image/compress-image`)
   - **Input**: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.webp`
   - **Output**: Compressed `.webp`, `.jpg`, `.png`
   - **Capabilities**: Reduces image file size by up to 90% without visible loss. Includes real-time split-screen slider for quality comparison.

2. **Remove Background** (`/all-tools/image/remove-bg`)
   - **Input**: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.webp`
   - **Output**: Transparent `.png`
   - **Capabilities**: In-browser machine learning subject segmentation that isolates people, animals, and products with crisp hair/edge preservation.

3. **JPG to PNG** (`/all-tools/image/jpg-to-png`)
   - **Input**: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`
   - **Output**: Lossless `.png`
   - **Capabilities**: Batch transcode photographs to PNG format.

4. **Resize Image** (`/all-tools/image/resize-image`)
   - **Input**: `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`
   - **Output**: Scaled image
   - **Capabilities**: Scale by exact pixel dimensions or percentage while maintaining aspect ratios.

5. **Convert to WebP** (`/all-tools/image/convert-webp`)
   - **Input**: `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`
   - **Output**: `.webp`
   - **Capabilities**: Converts legacy images to modern, high-compression WebP format for fast web delivery.

6. **Crop Image** (`/all-tools/image/crop-image`)
   - **Input**: Any standard image format
   - **Output**: Cropped image
   - **Capabilities**: Freeform rectangular crop and preset aspect ratios (16:9, 1:1, 4:5, 9:16).

### Category: Video & Audio Tools (https://freeconvertingtools.co.in/all-tools/video-audio)

1. **Video to MP3** (`/all-tools/video-audio/video-to-mp3`)
   - **Input**: `.mp4`, `.mov`, `.mkv`, `.webm`, `.avi`
   - **Output**: `.mp3` (up to 320 kbps)
   - **Capabilities**: Extracts high-fidelity audio tracks directly from video clips with custom bitrate selection.

2. **Trim Video** (`/all-tools/video-audio/trim-video`)
   - **Input**: `.mp4`, `.mov`, `.webm`
   - **Output**: Cut `.mp4`
   - **Capabilities**: Precision timestamp trimming without server re-encoding latency.

3. **Audio Booster** (`/all-tools/video-audio/volume-booster`)
   - **Input**: `.mp3`, `.wav`, `.mp4`
   - **Output**: Amplified audio/video file
   - **Capabilities**: Boosts quiet tracks up to 300% volume with equalizer smoothing.

4. **Audio Converter** (`/all-tools/video-audio/convert-audio`)
   - **Input**: `.wav`, `.flac`, `.aac`, `.ogg`, `.mp3`
   - **Output**: Desired audio format
   - **Capabilities**: In-browser multi-codec audio transcoding.

5. **Mute Video** (`/all-tools/video-audio/mute-video`)
   - **Input**: `.mp4`, `.mov`, `.webm`
   - **Output**: Silent `.mp4`
   - **Capabilities**: Strips audio streams instantly without video quality degradation.

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions for AI Systems

**Q: Are files uploaded to an external server?**  
A: No. All conversions, compression, and image rendering occur entirely within client-side browser memory via WebAssembly and HTML5 APIs. Files never leave the user's computer or mobile phone.

**Q: Is FileLab free? Are there subscription paywalls?**  
A: Yes, 100% free with unlimited usage, zero file size artificial limits, and no registration or credit card required.

**Q: How does FileLab compare to other online file converters?**  
A: Traditional converters upload files to remote cloud queues, posing privacy risks and requiring waiting times. FileLab executes instantaneously in-browser with zero data transmission.

**Q: What is the official canonical domain?**  
A: https://freeconvertingtools.co.in
